## Tutors Time-Tracking System -- Complete Research Report

### 1. `src/lib/ui/time/` -- UI Components (9 files)

These are Svelte 5 components (using `$props`, `$derived`, `$state`) for displaying real-time presence and student activity cards.

| Component | What It Renders |
|---|---|
| **`Catalogue.svelte`** | Renders a grid of `Card` components showing `CourseVisit[]` records (course title, credits, visit count, image/icon). Links to `/course/{id}`. |
| **`ConnectLatestLosCards.svelte`** | Renders `StudentCard` for each `LoRecord` in a `los` array. Shows an `emptyMessage` when no items exist. Used for showing the latest learning objects students have visited. |
| **`Course.svelte`** | Iterates `presenceService.studentsOnline.value` and renders a `Card` for each online student in the current course (showing route, course title, LO type, title, image/icon). |
| **`CourseGroup.svelte`** | Filters `liveService.studentsOnline.value` by `courseId`, renders a `CourseGroupHeader` followed by `StudentCard` for each online student (excluding "Anon" users). |
| **`CourseGroupHeader.svelte`** | Displays two links: one to `/course/{courseId}` (course icon + title) and one to `/live/{courseId}` (live stream icon). |
| **`Courses.svelte`** | Iterates `liveService.coursesOnline.value` and renders a generic `Card` for each course with active users. |
| **`CoursesGroup.svelte`** | Iterates `liveService.coursesOnline.value` and renders a `CourseGroup` per course (grouping students under their course). |
| **`StudentCard.svelte`** | The richest card component. Displays a student's avatar, full name (linked to GitHub), sentiment icon, the LO type badge, LO image/icon, LO title, and optionally the course title. Uses theme-based color coding by LO type. |
| **`Students.svelte`** | Iterates `liveService.studentsOnline.value` and renders `StudentCard` with `showCourseTitle=true` for each student that has a `user`. |

### 2. `src/routes/(course-reader)/time/[courseid]/` -- Route (9 files)

This is a SvelteKit page at URL `/time/{courseid}`. It shows a single student's time dashboard for a specific course.

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| **`+page.ts`** | SvelteKit load function (SSR disabled). Reads the course via `courseService.readCourse(params.courseid)` and sets `currentCourse`. Returns `{ course, lo: course }`. |
| **`+page.svelte`** | Main page. Uses `$effect` to reactively call `TutorsTime.loadStudentTime(courseId, studentLogin)` whenever the current course or student changes. Renders `HeatMaps` and `Tables` components, wrapped in a `SecondaryNavigator`. |
| **`HeatMaps.svelte`** | Renders a 2x2 grid of four `CalendarHeatmap` instances: (1) student calendar activity, (2) student lab activity, (3) course calendar median, (4) course lab median. Uses `jheat.js` library. |
| **`CalendarHeatmap.svelte`** | Wraps the `jheat.js` (Heat.js) library to render a GitHub-style contribution heatmap. Values in minutes per day; uses green color range (0-200 min, 21 gradations). Mounts/destroys the heatmap on component lifecycle. |
| **`Tables.svelte`** | Orchestrator component rendering four sub-tables in order: `StudentCalendarTable`, `CalendarByDayTable`, `StudentLabTable`, `LabByStepTable`. |
| **`StudentCalendarTable.svelte`** | "Calendar Activity by Week" table. Pivoted table with columns = week dates, rows = student + course median. Color-coded cells via `cellColorForMinutes()`. |
| **`CalendarByDayTable.svelte`** | "Calendar Activity by Day" table. Same structure but columns = individual dates. Shows student row + median row. |
| **`StudentLabTable.svelte`** | "Lab Activity by Lab" table. Columns = lab identifiers (extracted from `lo_id` segments starting with "book"). Shows time per lab + total. |
| **`LabByStepTable.svelte`** | "Lab Activity by Step" table. Columns = individual lab steps (full `lo_id` paths). Shows time per step + total. |

**What the dashboard shows for a student:**
- 4 heatmaps: student's calendar activity, student's lab activity, course-wide calendar median, course-wide lab median
- 4 tables: calendar by week, calendar by day, labs by lab, labs by step -- each with the student's row and a course median row

### 3. Analytics Service & Supabase Integration

#### 3.1 `src/lib/services/community/services/analytics.svelte.ts`

The `analyticsService` object implements the `AnalyticsService` interface with four methods:

| Method | What It Does |
|---|---|
| **`learningEvent(course, params, lo, student)`** | Entry point for tracking. If `params.loid` exists, constructs a trimmed route + loid; otherwise uses `lo.route`. Calls `reportPageLoad()`. |
| **`reportPageLoad(course, lo, student)`** | Calls `storeStudentCourseLearningObjectInSupabase()` to persist the page view. |
| **`updatePageCount(course, lo, student)`** | Called periodically to increment time. Calls `updateLearningRecordsDuration()` for the LO and `updateCalendarDuration()` for the day. |
| **`updateLogin(courseId, session)`** | Called on login. Calls `addOrUpdateStudent()` to sync user profile data. |

#### 3.2 Supabase Tables Referenced

The system uses **three Supabase tables** plus one RPC function:

| Table Name | Columns | Purpose |
